name: Fropple
dexEntry: These tiny Grass type Pokémon wander the forests of the Lumora Region light-heartedly. Usually they go about their everyday lives by dangling from trees, eating Bug type Pokémon and berries and sleep for the rest of the day. Fropple are really easy to take care of as they don't require a lot of attention, but recent studies show they are a lot happier when with somebody else on their side. They also seem to have a friendly rivalry with Applin.
